explanation: cos(theta*) = 1.3 has |cos(theta*)| > 1, which is not a physical angle. This is not the known pole-safe clamping case (cos=±1.0), so clamping 1.3 to 0.999 would silently fabricate a different kinematic point. The request is ill-posed as stated — the user should supply a cosine in [-1, +1].
